messages.subject: Error handling and dateRangeInput
parts:
I am using dateRangeInput in a Shiny application that I have deployed to shinyapps.io. My problem is that the application crashes when the user enters an invalid date. I would like the application to respond gracefully by setting default values instead of crashing. 

The same problem occurs with the example in the Shiny gallery at http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/date-and-date-range.html. If the user enters the date 20155-02-23 then the application crashes.
